The '''ion rifle''' was a type of [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] that fired ion energy instead of blaster bolts. This type of energy disrupted electrical systems, making it an effective weapon against [[Droid/Legends|droids]], vehicles, electronic devices, and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically enhanced]] creatures. It was larger and more powerful that the [[ion pistol]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Variants of the ion rifle included the [[Baragwin Ion-X weapon]], an experimental weapon of [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] design modified by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] merchant [[Suvam Tan]]. [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] produced another couple variants, namely the the [[DEMP Ion Carbine/Legends|Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse Ion Carbine]] and the [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine]].

A couple of ion rifles were mounted onto the [[SD-6 Hulk infantry droid]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
